question: How many tracks are in the store?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Track;

question: How many invoices were billed to Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany';

question: How many distinct countries do customers come from?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Country) FROM Customer;

question: How many invoices were issued in each month of 2024? Show the month number and count, ordered by month.
gold_sql: SELECT month(InvoiceDate) AS month, count(*) FROM Invoice WHERE year(InvoiceDate) = 2024 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

question: How many customers have a company listed?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Customer WHERE Company IS NOT NULL;

question: List each Canadian city where customers live, once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT City FROM Customer WHERE Country = 'Canada';

question: How many invoices have more than 10 line items?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT InvoiceId FROM InvoiceLine GROUP BY InvoiceId HAVING count(*) > 10);

question: Which billing country has the highest average invoice total?
gold_sql: SELECT BillingCountry FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY avg(Total) DESC LIMIT 1;

question: List each region once.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM countries;

question: What are the first and last years covered by the country statistics?
gold_sql: SELECT min(year), max(year) FROM country_stats;

question: How many countries have 'island' in their name?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM countries WHERE name ILIKE '%island%';

question: Which high income countries are in North America?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM countries WHERE region = 'North America' AND income_group = 'High income';

question: What was the average life expectancy across countries in 2000?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(life_expectancy_years) FROM country_stats WHERE year = 2000;

question: Which countries had more than 95% of people using the internet in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE s.year = 2022 AND s.internet_users_pct > 95;

question: Which high income countries had a fertility rate above 2.1 in 2023? Show the name and fertility rate.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, s.fertility_rate FROM country_stats s JOIN countries c ON c.iso3 = s.iso3 WHERE c.income_group = 'High income' AND s.year = 2023 AND s.fertility_rate > 2.1;

question: How many penguins were observed in 2008?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins WHERE year = 2008;

question: Which species live on Torgersen island?
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT species FROM penguins WHERE island = 'Torgersen';

question: How many female Adelie penguins were recorded on Dream island?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Adelie' AND sex = 'female' AND island = 'Dream';

question: How many penguins weigh more than 5 kilograms?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM penguins WHERE body_mass_g > 5000;

question: What is the average body mass of Chinstrap penguins in kilograms?
gold_sql: SELECT avg(body_mass_g) / 1000.0 FROM penguins WHERE species = 'Chinstrap';
